name: fixed_library_ppo_v1
purpose: Test parameter learning of a fixed real historical visual library, separating weight changes from immediate context. Explicit conditional-curriculum mechanism variant, not online empty-library bootstrap or paper-exact replication.

training.optimizer: unchanged verified standard full-parameter PPO configuration; no search
training.distillation: current-policy self side-channel only; no library additions

arms.A: ordinary PPO immutable empty training library
arms.B: identical PPO with immutable final B five-card historical library from bootstrap_card_pair_v1

training_curriculum.selection: Fixed ascending candidate pool, first32 exact new states in each declared category, interleave8/category per32 batch. No model-output selection.

evaluation.midpoint_context: both contexts, same full Dev96 cross before safety decision

randomness_limits: Installed SGLang has no supported per-request sampling_seed. Record actual server seed and request order; no claim of identical stochastic streams or stable multi-seed performance. Greedy eval/distill use installed argmax branch and do not draw stochastic sampling RNG. Critic head initialized with explicit paired torch seed under fork_rng and full small head values compared across arms.

numerical_gates.scope: Use real first training batch, no synthetic replacement or new model generations; extra forward time recorded; not SGLang-vs-actor probability proof.
numerical_gates.tolerance_reason: Before first new model request: same BF16 weights checked across eval/train execution paths, allow max.05 nats and mean.005 (well below .2 PPO clip), record exact errors; not a bitwise equality or SGLang backend check.

midpoint_stop: After2 batches, if training-context natural Dev multi success declines by>=4/53 or quality declines by>=4/53 relative to same-context baseline, stop that arm at2 and save complete partial evidence. No best checkpoint selection or replacement.
primary_learning_claim: On new conditional Dev32 with the SAME fixed library context, B-after must improve over BOTH B-before and A-after; report paired full success and quality differences/intervals. Never compare B+card only to b0 empty as learning.
next_investment_gate: Both arms complete4, numerical/input/paired-head checks pass; conditional same-library B-self and B-A each success AND quality net>=4/32 with <=2 regressions; natural multistep B-self decline<4. Pilot investment rule only, not stable or general learning evidence. If no pass close protocol without extra batch or seed.

checkpoint.consequence: All weight-by-context evaluation in living trainer, theta4 lost on exit; no independent restore/full F claim.

stop: 4 batches/arm maximum (not continuation of old bootstrap), no rerun completed requests/updates, no extra fifth batch or source skill admission, no tuning from Dev/Test, absolute total clock unchanged, 2GB cap with1.8GB write-stop reserve. Lambda remains0.
preflight_design_note: Before all new model calls, use full0/2/4 context crossing so a safety stop at2 retains both contexts without replay; no data/outcome selection change.
